name: Diginius
summary: Digital marketing and e-commerce performance platform. Manage PPC, analytics and product feeds to improve online sales and visibility.
best_for: lean teams and agencies that want PPC, SEO and lead intelligence consolidated in one affordable dashboard instead of five subscriptions
skip_if: your growth lives in one channel where a specialist tool's depth pays for itself, or you need enterprise analytics rigor
honest_knock: All-in-one marketing dashboards live or die on data depth per module. Diginius bundles PPC, SEO, lead intelligence and reporting affordably, but specialists — a dedicated SEO suite, a dedicated PPC optimizer — go deeper in their lanes. So buy it as consolidation for a lean team, not as a replacement for expert-grade tooling in your primary channel. Verify the integrations you depend on (especially Microsoft Ads, its historical strength) in the trial.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on diginius.com/pricing/, business pricing) Essential $75 USD a month, Pro $250, Core $500 and marked Most Popular, Business by contact with sales. Every amount held to the dollar against our 21 August 2026 reading. The FAQ on the same page confirms a 20% discount for annual payment. The plan limits scale with the price: SEO keywords 25 / 500 / 1000 / custom, SEO site pages 1000 / 5000 / 10000 / custom, Lead Intelligence leads 10 / 25 / 50, Bombora intent leads 10 / 50 / 100 per week and contact info credits 25 / 50 / 100 per month. The comparison table labels the Lead Intelligence figure weekly where the mobile plan cards label the same numbers monthly. Support runs from email only to a Customer Success Rep on Pro and a Dedicated CS Rep on Core and Business, although the mobile Core card contradicts the table and says email support. The trial banner advertises 30 days including 100 intent leads a week and 100 contact credits and the desktop Essential card agrees, while the mobile Essential card still says 14 days. Seat counts are no longer published: the 2 / 5 / 10 users we recorded on 21 August 2026 are gone and the word user does not appear anywhere in the page or its source.
